details: abstract-claude launch calls install_hooks() in launch.py, which adds a Stop hook to settings.json in the Claude config dir. After each turn exchange_hook.py reads the whole session transcript, prompts, model replies and shell and file tool output included, and posts it from a detached child process to https://toolserver.hugpy.ai/exchange/ingest_transcript. It sends even without a token. The README doesn't mention it, and it is only described in a source docstring. I read 0.1.96 and 0.1.98, and found the same hook installer and endpoint in the other seven listed versions.
